controles.affirmation: Hook : « le 13 juillet 2026, trois jours AVANT la cloture du trimestre, elle a signe l'acquisition de FWI Holdings pour 1,6 Md$ ».
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 (FERG_2026-08-10.htm.gz), page de couverture : "For the quarterly period ended June 30, 2026". Note 14 Subsequent event : "On July 13, 2026, the Company announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire FWI Holdings, Inc. for approximately $1.6 billion." Le 13 juillet 2026 est 13 jours APRES la cloture du 30 juin 2026, et l'operation est classee en evenement posterieur a la cloture.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : « le 13 juillet 2026, treize jours apres la cloture du trimestre ». Le mot « avant » inverse la chronologie et fait croire que l'acquisition est deja dans le bilan publie, ce qui est faux.

controles.affirmation: L'acquisition FWI Holdings a ete annoncee « trois jours apres la cloture du T2 » (repete deux fois dans le corps et le bloc quantitatif).
controles.verbatim_source: Meme verbatim : trimestre clos le 30 juin 2026, annonce le 13 juillet 2026, soit treize jours apres.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer « trois jours apres » par « treize jours apres » aux trois occurrences (hook, fondamental_interne, quantitatif).

controles.affirmation: Le 10-KT signale POUR LA PREMIERE FOIS un risque de consolidation par des acteurs non traditionnels et d'adoption de l'IA generative ou agentique par certains concurrents, facteur nouveau qui n'apparaissait pas dans les documents anterieurs.
controles.verbatim_source: Le 10-K precedent (FERG_2025-09-26.htm.gz, exercice clos le 31 juillet 2025) contient deja les deux elements : "changes in competition, including as a result of market consolidation, new entrants, vertical integration or competitors responding more quickly to emerging technologies (such as generative artificial intelligence (“AI”))" et "the industries in which we operate may be disrupted by non-traditional competitors through acquisitions of traditional competitors to expand their capabilities". Seul l'adjectif « agentique » est nouveau dans le 10-KT.
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer la mention « pour la premiere fois » et « n'apparaissait pas dans les documents anterieurs ». Au mieux : « le 10-KT elargit la formulation existante de l'IA generative a l'IA agentique ».

controles.affirmation: Flux de tresorerie operationnel a 716 M$ sur six mois contre 1 123 M$ (-36 %), attribue au fonds de roulement et au decalage des paiements d'impots et de primes lie au passage a un exercice calendaire ; resultat net +10,3 % (1 080 M$ contre 979 M$).
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Net cash provided by operating activities was $716 million and $1,123 million for the year-to-date periods of 2026 and 2025, respectively. The $407 million decrease was mainly due to an increased investment in working capital and the timing of both income tax payments and cash incentive payouts due to the transition to a calendar year-end". Compte de resultat : Net income 1,080 / 979. Calculs verifies : -36,2 % et +10,3 %.

controles.affirmation: Dette totale passee de 4,1 Mds$ (31/12/2025) a 4,9 Mds$ (30/06/2026), +19 %, dont 525 M$ sur la ligne de titrisation et 250 M$ sur le revolver ; conformite a tous les covenants ; 1,6 Md$ de liquidite disponible sur facilites non tirees.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, note Debt : "Receivables Facility $525 / $—" ; "Revolving Facility 250 / —" ; total debt "$4,904 / $4,126" ; "The Company was in compliance with all debt covenants that were in effect as of June 30, 2026." ; "In addition to cash, the Company had $1.6 billion of available liquidity from undrawn debt facilities as of June 30, 2026." Calcul verifie : 4904/4126 = +18,9 %.

controles.affirmation: 438 M$ de rachats d'actions sur S1 2026 contre 428 M$ sur S1 2025 ; nouveau programme de 2 Mds$ autorise le 30 avril 2026, remplaçant un programme de 5 Mds$ dont 4,7 Mds$ utilises.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Share repurchases under the Company's authorized share repurchase programs were $438 million and $428 million for the year-to-date periods of 2026 and 2025, respectively." ; "As of April 30, 2026, the Company had completed $4.7 billion in share repurchases under a September 2021 program that authorized up to $5.0 billion. On April 30, 2026, the Board authorized a new share repurchase program of up to $2 billion in aggregate purchases of common stock, replacing the prior program."

controles.affirmation: Taux d'imposition effectif de 19,7 % a 21,3 % au T2 2026 et de 22,2 % a 23,2 % sur le semestre, attribue a des ajustements sur positions fiscales d'exercices anterieurs.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The Company's effective tax rates were 21.3% and 19.7% for the second quarters of 2026 and 2025, respectively. The Company's effective tax rates were 23.2% and 22.2% for the year-to-date periods of 2026 and 2025, respectively. In both year-over-year comparisons, the higher effective tax rates were primarily driven by adjustments related to prior year tax positions."

controles.affirmation: CA du segment Canada a 408 M$ au T2 2026, -1,9 % (-8 M$), dont -3,6 % lie aux cessions d'activites non strategiques ; segment a environ 5 % du CA groupe.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Net sales for the Canada segment were $408 million in the second quarter of 2026, a decrease of $8 million, or 1.9%, compared with the second quarter of 2025. This decrease in net sales was primarily driven by the impact of non-core business divestments of 3.6%, along with lower sales volume, partially offset by low-single digit price inflation." Poids verifie : 408 / 8 751 = 4,7 %.

controles.affirmation: Ventes residentielles US +1 % sur le semestre, non-residentiel (environ la moitie du CA US) +8 %.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Net sales in residential markets increased 1% compared with the year-to-date period of 2025 due to growth in HVAC, partially offset by weak new construction activity and soft repair, maintenance and improvement (RMI) work" ; "Net sales in non-residential markets increased approximately 8% compared with the year-to-date period of 2025" ; "Net sales in non-residential markets, representing approximately half of revenue in the United States".

controles.affirmation: Tarifs et tarifs reciproques annonces par les Etats-Unis en 2025 sur une large gamme de produits ; environ 37 000 fournisseurs dans le monde.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-KT (FERG_2026-02-27.htm.gz) : "In 2025, the U.S. announced tariffs and reciprocal tariffs on a wide range of products" ; "As of December 31, 2025, we had approximately 37,000 suppliers located in various countries around the world."

controles.affirmation: Resultat operationnel ajuste 932 M$ au T2 2026 (+2,9 %) contre GAAP 893 M$ (+6,1 %), ecart explique par 21 M$ de charges de restructuration non recurrentes au T2 2025.
controles.verbatim_source: Chiffres exacts : 10-Q T2 2026, "Operating profit 893 / 842" (+6,06 %) et "Adjusted operating profit 932 / 906" (+2,87 %). Note 13 : "Business restructuring expenses — / 21" et "Restructuring expenses $2 / $25" au T2. Mais l'ecart GAAP/ajuste est de 39 M$ en 2026 et de 64 M$ en 2025 : le seul retraitement des 21 M$ n'explique pas l'ecart, qui inclut d'autres elements (restructuration corporate, amortissements d'incorporels acquis).
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : « le T2 2025 portait 25 M$ de charges de restructuration au total, dont 21 M$ de restructuration operationnelle non recurrente ; le reste de l'ecart entre GAAP et ajuste tient a d'autres retraitements non-GAAP ». Ne pas presenter les 21 M$ comme l'explication unique.
